kernel.description: Path to an uncompressed kernel image (vmlinux) to include kernel code size in systemwide output.

realmem.description: Amount of physical RAM (e.g., '1024M', '8G') to detect firmware/hardware memory usage and base percentages on.

source.description: Path to an alternate /proc data source, typically a .tar file generated by smemcap.

mappings.description: If true, reports memory usage by mapping instead of by process.

users.description: If true, reports memory usage by user instead of by process.

system.description: If true, reports systemwide memory usage summary.

autosize.description: If true, auto-sizes columns to fit terminal width.

columns.description: List of column names to display (e.g., PSS, USS, Swap, SwapP). If empty, uses default columns.

no_header.description: If true, disables the header line in the output.

abbreviate.description: If true, shows unit suffixes (K, M, G) for memory values.

numeric.description: If true, shows numeric user IDs instead of usernames.

percent.description: If true, shows memory usage as percentages.

reverse.description: If true, reverses the sort order of the output.

sort.description: Field name to sort the output by (e.g., PSS, USS, Swap, Pid, Name).

totals.description: If true, shows a totals line at the bottom of the output.

bar.description: Field name to use for bar graph generation (requires matplotlib).

pie.description: Field name to use for pie graph generation (requires matplotlib).
